title: RCCA closure integrity: EOS guideline status drifted from closed work; G8 failure-mode checks absent; learning-routing loop unexercised

rcca.root_cause: Guidelines were treated as narrative: their status labels/coverage were updated at design time, not re-derived when the tracked work closed; the RCCA->learning routing existed in code but no writer path exercised it.
rcca.corrective: Sync EOS s12 labels to closed work; add G8 failure-mode checks; exercise the loop e2e.
rcca.preventive: Every RCCA must record generalized+guideline_ref; a regression test asserts issue->RCCA->learning->guideline and the fail-closed close gate; EOS labels reviewed on close.
